_sample_note: Sample 05 (reference suite): ingestion of AES-256 password-protected ZIP archives, decrypted on the fly, fully self-contained in the {{catalog}}.flowx_sample schema. The seed notebook (notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/04_seed_sample_05_encrypted_ingestion_data.py) builds one password-protected ZIP per iteration IN-PROCESS with pyzipper (AES-256, never a pre-built binary fixture), protected with the SAME UC secret Sample 04's export side uses: {{catalog}}.flowx_sample.sample_zip_passkey. At pipeline runtime, source_zip_handling.pre_extraction_decryption.secret_passphrase resolves that secret and pyzipper extracts the archive before Auto Loader ingests the contained CSV (ingestion/readers.py -> archive/zip_utils.py::extract_encrypted_zip). Note the shape: secret_passphrase is the ZIP archive's OWN password and lives under pre_extraction_decryption WITHOUT a 'type' key -- 'type' is only for an outer whole-file envelope such as PGP (see flowx_testing/014_ing_005_pgp_decrypt.json for that combinable variant). MANUAL PREREQUISITE: the UC secret must exist before the seed or the pipeline runs -- both fail fast with a clear message if it does not; see the job resource header (resources/sample_jobs/flowx_sample_05_encrypted_ingestion_job.yml).

ingestion_flows.source_description: Sample 05: per-iteration AES-256 password-protected ZIP batches (sample_secure_txns_iter1..3.zip, each a distinct samples.tpch.orders-derived transaction slice) are decrypted via the {{catalog}}.flowx_sample.sample_zip_passkey UC secret, extracted, and Auto Loader-ingested into an APPEND streaming table -- all inside one Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline update.
